source_semantics.persistence: ApplicationSettings keyed as SiteBrain.{siteId:N} and read AsNoTracking.
source_semantics.missing_or_blank: Returns the source default SiteBrain profile.
source_semantics.malformed_json: Returns the source default SiteBrain profile instead of surfacing a parse failure.
source_semantics.default_contract: Arabic; Professional; General audience; Auto detect SEO/page builder; Black, white and readable gold; 1200x630; natural contextual links; clear parent/child categories; factual concise content; responsive accessible design; organic-traffic goal; two articles per week; autopilot disabled.

laravel_adaptation.persistence: Existing scoped_settings site scope with tenant_id, site_key, key=site_brain.profile and non-secret JSON value.
laravel_adaptation.site_authority: Site::query()->findOrFail runs under the existing tenant global scope before any setting lookup.
laravel_adaptation.fail_safe: Missing, blank, malformed, or non-object JSON resolves to the source-equivalent defaults.
laravel_adaptation.stored_identity_rule: Persisted site_id is never trusted; returned site_id is always the authoritative active-tenant Site model ID.

tenant_isolation.proof: Focused Laravel acceptance creates Alpha and Beta tenant sites, activates Beta, and proves the Alpha site cannot be resolved through SiteBrainService::getAsync because the Site model tenant global scope raises ModelNotFoundException.
tenant_isolation.persistence_scope: The subsequent scoped_settings read is additionally constrained by TenantContext::id(), site scope, and the authoritative site key.
